regime.skew: call-side rich near ATM (-0.97), near-money put bid paid down
regime.label: Dealer short gamma across the whole 960-1150 grid, with the downside-protection burden unwinding into a 3-session stall at 1018
evidence: -5,795 net GEX (gamma x OI x 200) with cumulative net GEX negative at every one of the 20 listed strikes: there is no gamma flip inside 960-1150, so dealers are short gamma everywhere quoted and hedge with the move, not against it.
-2,036 net GEX in the 1010-1030 ATM band, and the chain's most negative cumulative reading is -11,032 at 1030, directly over spot 1018.1 - the amplification burden sits on top of price.

-1,066 put OI (16,049 to 14,983, -6.6%) and -71% total volume (9,545 to 2,766 contracts) in one session, with the 1000 near put wall shedding 364 OI on 229 lots: the protection built through the slide is being closed, the Unwind signature.
+494 net GEX at 1040 and +1,261 at 1050 - per-strike gamma turns positive on the 1040-1050 shelf, so upside into max pain 1040 gets dampened while the sub-1000 zone stays amplified.

S50Z26.today_summary: 1018.1 anchor, unchanged for a third session (1017.9 / 1018.2 / 1018.1, a 0.3-point range) after a 29.1-point slide off 1047.2. 0.58 P/C volume ratio - the lowest of the last 8 sessions, down from 0.98 - on 2,766 total contracts versus 9,545 yesterday, as put OI fell 1,066 and the 1000 near put wall lost 364 contracts. Max pain 1040 sits 21.9 points above spot while ATM IV compressed 0.82 point to 12.05%, pulling the 1-sigma day to 7.73 points. 25-delta skew at -0.97 (980 put 12.62% vs 1040 call 13.60%) with the 1020 put marked at 10.42% and the 1030 put at 9.88% - the near-money downside bid has been paid down, leaving the 960 wing put at 13.93% as the only elevated downside vol.
what_changed: Put OI dropped 1,066 to 14,983 (-6.6%) while call OI fell only 218 to 16,454, pushing the P/C OI ratio to 0.91 from 0.96 - the lowest reading of the window.
Volume collapsed 71% to 2,766 contracts (1,754 call / 1,012 put) from 9,545, and the P/C volume ratio halved to 0.58 - flow is call-side and thin.
Far-OTM call OI built against the tide: 1100 +295 to 2,621 on 375 lots, 1150 +55, 1090 +29 - the only strikes accumulating are 8%+ above spot.
25-delta skew moved 0.79 point more call-rich (-0.18 to -0.97) and both 25-delta bands slid 10 points (call 1050 to 1040, put 990 to 980) as ATM IV gave back 0.82 point to 12.05%.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: The decisive change is the GEX sign flip on 10-31: net gamma went +614 to -3,127 and the gamma flip strike vanished from 1110 to nowhere in the grid, converting dealers from fading moves to chasing them - and the anchor then fell 29.1 points from 1047.2 to 1018.1 with hedging flow pushing in the same direction. Max pain drifted down 10 points to 1040 on 11-04 and the near-money walls migrated 50 points lower on 10-30 (call 1100 to 1050, put 1020 to 1000), so the entire burden map reset one shelf down. Open interest built hard through the slide - call OI +31.8% (12,488 to 16,454) and put OI +28.7% (11,642 to 14,983) - and today is the first clear reversal of that build, concentrated in puts. ATM IV round-tripped 11.36% to a 12.87% peak on 11-05 and back to 12.05%, so the vol bid that financed the protection has deflated with price flat for three sessions. The structure is now short-gamma but unmanned: the amplifier is still wired below 1000, while the players who built it are walking away.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 1010 / 990
strategies.rationale: Cumulative net GEX is -8,996 at 1000 and -9,831 at 1010 and the 1000 wall just shed 364 OI, so the support that would have absorbed a probe is thinning exactly where dealers are most short gamma and would be forced to sell futures into a break (heatmap-zones.md short-gamma amplification); the 1010 put is marked at 10.89% IV, the cheap side of a -0.97 skew, making this the least expensive way to own that asymmetry.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 7.6 points net debit (1010 put at 15.9 ask, 990 put at 8.3 bid); max gain 12.4 points at/below 990; breakeven 1002.4.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1040, where per-strike net GEX turns +494 and the 1040-1050 shelf flips dealer hedging to dampening - the short-gamma amplification thesis is void above it.

strategies.name: Long strangle 1000 put / 1050 call
strategies.rationale: Short gamma at every listed strike with no flip to stabilise the chain means a break either way is hedged with the move, and ATM IV at 12.05% after giving back 0.82 point prices a 1-sigma day of only 7.73 points against a 50-point gap between the 1000 and 1050 strikes (option-strategy-building-blocks.md: direction unclear + cheap vol = direction-agnostic long vol).
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 19.9 points premium paid (1000 put 11.9 ask + 1050 call 8.0 ask); breakevens 980.1 and 1069.9, inside the 56.3-point 1-sigma move over the remaining 53 days.
strategies.invalidation: Continued 1010-1030 chop with ATM IV sliding under 11.5% - at 53 DTE theta and IV crush take the premium before a break develops; the 1050 call is also the rich leg at 13.60% IV.

S50Z26.prediction: 1018 is the level that matters: with dealers short gamma on the whole grid and the 1000 wall unwinding, a loss of 1000 opens 980 (25-delta) and then the 960 structural wall at 3,190 OI, while the 1040-1050 positive-gamma shelf caps rallies toward max pain 1040. The 0.58 P/C volume ratio and -71% volume argue the next move waits for new flow rather than this structure, and the Unwind zone's own prescription is to reduce engagement, not add it (regime-strategy-matrix.md). A close above 1040 invalidates the downside-amplification bias outright.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no recommendation to execute any trade. SET50 options are cash-settled on the SET50 index with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning and max-pain magnetism are structurally weaker than for share-settled single stocks: treat max pain 1040 as a tendency, not a target, especially at 53 DTE where ATM gamma is far from its expiry spike. Defined risk is not risk-free - the 7.6-point and 19.9-point max losses are real and can be lost in full. The 1100 call wall (2,621 OI, 8.0% above spot) and the 960 put wall (3,190 OI, 5.7% below) both fail the Vol2Vol proximity test and should not be weighted as active magnets; macro or news flow can override the option structure entirely.
